findings.finding: Supply that can act inside the window: $83.2m (≈26m shares at $3.19, ~50% of the basic float) remains on the Virtu ATM under an effective shelf (last EFFECT 2025-11-26, file 333-290712), and the first 20% tranche of January 2026 pre-funded warrants (~33.5m shares at $0.05, exercisable since 2026-07-16) is live, while the stock still trades ~3.3x fully-diluted NAV, which makes every ATM share sold accretive to the company.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM needs no further filing to sell during the 10-07 session; the company's Q3 cash/token update was published 10-05, so any self-imposed quarter-end restraint is plausibly lifted (inference). Shares outstanding were unchanged 9-18 → 10-02 (51,751,359 both dates), so the company did NOT sell into the spike — the supply is unspent, not finished.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-10-07 — sales would hit the tape during the session; they become VISIBLE only in the Q3 10-Q (Nov), so the price effect is in window, the disclosure is not
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 ATM use was small: $84.5m remaining at 6-30 (10-Q) vs $83.2m at 9-30 (8-K), i.e. ~$1.3m sold in the quarter; H1 2026 sold 2,693,853 shares for $15.5m. So the company has used the ATM sparingly and not into this spike — which is why this finding is sized small.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has re-rated toward fully-diluted value but at $3.19 still sits ~3.3x FD NAV ($0.96); if the market held a live, accretive ATM and exercisable warrants as near-certain supply, it would trade much nearer FD NAV. What it has not taken is the company/warrant holders actually selling into the remaining premium.
